gaps.feature: Working live model replies (provider keys + Send path)
gaps.adrians_today: Composer + streaming path exist; Send fails without XAI_API_KEY; other providers refused/disabled.
gaps.why: Highest user impact — without replies the rest of the OS is a shell. Competitors all expose a usable send path (guest or signed-in).

gaps.feature: Model / effort / thinking-level picker wired to real catalogs
gaps.adrians_today: Presentational Auto/Fast/Expert/Heavy/Build menu; provider radios mostly disabled; no effort API.
gaps.why: Users expect to choose speed vs depth; Poe/HuggingChat advertise large catalogs even on public pages.

gaps.feature: Web search + Deep research with citations in-chat
gaps.adrians_today: Research view + citation filter code; blocked without MIND_SEARCH_ENDPOINT/KEY; ChatGPT public UI gates Deep research behind login.
gaps.why: Core daily-use differentiator for research OS positioning; Perplexity/You.com are search-first.

gaps.feature: In-thread tool-execution timeline + live activity rail
gaps.adrians_today: Runs/Activity are separate views; no Executing-tools card or right-rail Agent Activity Live in chat.
gaps.why: Makes agent work legible during a turn; reference board already shows the target UX.

gaps.feature: Connectors/plugins that actually OAuth-connect
gaps.adrians_today: ServiceBoard Setup shows detail only; Gmail OAuth stub; Notion/MCP often unconfigured.
gaps.why: Command OS value depends on mail/drive/git/notion; competitors ship connectable catalogs.

gaps.feature: Cloud file sources (Drive / OneDrive / library attach)
gaps.adrians_today: Local attach/stage only; Drive card Not connected.
gaps.why: Users attach work docs from cloud; local-only is a daily friction.

gaps.feature: Guest / logged-out usable chat (progressive auth)
gaps.adrians_today: Page loads signed-out but protected ops 401; no guest trial send.
gaps.why: Public capture cycle shows competitors let users start before full auth; improves activation.

gaps.feature: Full-duplex / Live voice mode
gaps.adrians_today: Dictate + one-shot Speak; registry voice=configured but not realtime.
gaps.why: High desire; owner previously deferred until management key — still a ranked gap.

gaps.feature: Image generation in composer (+ shopping/vision assistants)
gaps.adrians_today: Image analyze hook; generation paid_required / not called.
gaps.why: Visible on public competitor homes; Meta AI leans shopping+images.

gaps.feature: Keyboard shortcut sheet + composer ⌘K polish
gaps.adrians_today: Palette exists; full shortcut help sheet and ref-style composer ⌘K incomplete.
gaps.why: Power-user velocity; cheap win vs competitors' Ctrl+/ sheets.

gaps.feature: Projects with progress / agent stats dashboard
gaps.adrians_today: Local projects create/list; no % complete / agent stats cards like reference grid.
gaps.why: Projects exist but feel thin vs competitor + blueprint UI.

gaps.feature: Scheduled automations that run unattended
gaps.adrians_today: Scheduled UI + local due queue; hosted worker exits without DATABASE_URL.
gaps.why: Command OS promise includes schedules; needs durable DB + worker host.

gaps.feature: Artifacts / Canvas / Studio build surface
gaps.adrians_today: Build view cards report Not available / computer not paired.
gaps.why: Coding/create surfaces are competitor table-stakes; blocked on pairing.

gaps.feature: Multi-bot / character / persona directory
gaps.adrians_today: Bots & Agents + templates exist but not a discoverable persona marketplace UI.
gaps.why: Engagement pattern from Character.AI/Poe; Adrian has fleet primitives to build on.

gaps.feature: Omni / auto model routing across open models
gaps.adrians_today: chat.router capability marked ready locally; no multi-model auto router to external catalogs.
gaps.why: HuggingChat Omni + You Inference Router are public differentiators.

gaps.feature: Memory UX depth (editable prefs, import, toggles in attach)
gaps.adrians_today: Memory view with scopes/versions; thinner than competitor settings + attach toggles.
gaps.why: Trust + personalization; local memory already works — UX depth is the gap.

gaps.feature: Settings information architecture (billing, data, voice, shortcuts)
gaps.adrians_today: Settings thinner: appearance, import/export, requirements, failover note.
gaps.why: Users hunt for data controls and shortcuts; competitors have deep trees.

gaps.feature: Suggestion chips / starter prompts on empty chat
gaps.adrians_today: Greeting exists; rich chip grids like HuggingChat less prominent.
gaps.why: Activation UX; low effort polish.

gaps.feature: Cowork / shared workspaces / Work IQ style modes
gaps.adrians_today: Single-owner workspace; no cowork surface.
gaps.why: Enterprise/collab wedge; lower than personal daily gaps but visible on Copilot marketing.

gaps.feature: Mobile app / PWA install path polished
gaps.adrians_today: iPhone Add to Home Screen documented as blocker/manual; no strong public install CTA.
gaps.why: Distribution; competitors push apps on public pages.

gaps.feature: Screen-state design system (Loading/Empty/Error/Success tokens)
gaps.adrians_today: Failure banner improved; full state token system incomplete vs blueprint.
gaps.why: Consistency and trust; visual polish pass already targeting related issues.

gaps.feature: MCP / agent-intern modes in chat (tool-using specialist)
gaps.adrians_today: MCP client stubs + skills list; not a first-class 'ML Intern'-style mode chip.
gaps.why: HuggingChat publicly ships MCP-backed intern mode; aligns with Adrian skills/MCP direction.

gaps.feature: Auth provider variety on public wall (Google/Microsoft/Apple/phone)
gaps.adrians_today: Email/password + existing auth stack; fewer social options than ChatGPT public wall.
gaps.why: Reduces signup friction when opening the product beyond owner.

gaps.feature: Durable cloud DB + hosted worker for multi-device sync
gaps.adrians_today: Browser snapshot + embedded PGLite; DATABASE_URL unset; hosted worker blocked.
gaps.why: Foundation for schedules, sync, and multi-device — platform gap more than a single UI widget.

gaps.feature: Healthy REA / reverse-engineering doctor environment
gaps.adrians_today: REA pinned but doctor unhealthy; native engines missing.
gaps.why: Unique Command OS capability vs chat apps; ranks last among UI gaps because env/install, not competitor parity.
